8/🐶 Meme Culture Power

$BELLS is not just code – it’s culture.

Like $DOGE, it taps into nostalgia, humor, and community.

It’s a meme coin with actual technical fundamentals. And that combo is rare

5/💡 Tech Highlights

🔹 Proof-of-Work (merge-mined with $DOGE + $LTC)
🔹 Logarithmic halving – mining gets harder over time
🔹 Random block rewards – adds a game-like feel
🔹 Fixed supply – only 60M $BELLS, 58M already mined

4/🔥 The Revival

A group of passionate devs & fans revived the original chain in late 2023.

✅ Original supply capped at 60M
✅ Random mining rewards
✅ Deflationary PoW token
✅ Merge mining with $DOGE and $LTC
✅ OG meme roots

#Rebirth

2/🕹️ The Origin Story

$BELLS launched in 2013, inspired by the currency from Animal Crossing 🎮.

It was created just weeks after $DOGE by Billy Markus (yes, the same Dogecoin dev!), but it faded quickly.

Why? It was too early for its time.

If Dogecoin had a younger sibling, it would be Bellscoin.
Quiet, underestimated, but very real.
When the next meme wave hits, don’t be surprised if $BELLS rings louder than ever.

What is Bellscoin?
Bellscoin ($BELLS) was launched in late 2013 by Billy Markus — the same guy who co-created Dogecoin.
It was inspired by the currency used in Animal Crossing: Bells. Cute, lighthearted, and built for fun.
